recycled_content.source_quote: made from 100 % recycled PLA. The raw material is post-industrial waste from the manufacturing of food packaging, from discarded and failed 3D prints that were shredded and re-melted, and from filament that didn't meet our high quality standards.
recycled_content.notes: Source lists post-industrial food-packaging waste plus discarded/failed 3D prints and off-spec filament; whether the prints are post-consumer is not stated, so type unknown.

carbon_footprints.source_quote: To make a 1 kg spool of recycled KiwiFil rPLA pro filament (including the box and all-paper spool), the CO2 equivalent footprint is approximately 0.5 kg.
carbon_footprints.notes: Brand's own approximate estimate (no LCA study): 0.1 kg raw-material sea transport + 0.2 kg electricity (2 kWh NZ mix) + 0.1 kg spool/box; excludes delivery to customer. No burden assigned to the recycled PLA itself. Value stated as 'approximately'.
